title: Scalar Field Static Spherically Symmetric Solutions in Teleparallel F(t) Gravity
content: We investigate in this paper the static radial coordinate dependent spherically symmetric spacetime in teleparallel F(T) gravity for a scalar field source. We begin by setting the static field equations (FEs) to be solved and solve the conservation laws for scalar field potential solutions. We simplify the FEs and then find a general formula for computing the new teleparallel F(T) solutions applicable for any scalar field potential V(T) and coframe ansatz. We compute new non-trivial teleparallel F(T) solutions by using a power-law coframe ansatz for each scalar potential case arising from the conservation laws. We apply this formula to find new exact teleparallel F(T) solutions for several cases of coframe ansatz parameter. The new F(T) solution classes may be relevant for various astrophysical applications inside any dark energy (DE) source described by a fundamental scalar field such as quintessence, phantom energy or quintom system to name only those types.
